Only source change: src/input/fast_path.rs, FastPathInputEvent::encode.
Add the missing MouseEventRel(pdu) => pdu.encode(dst)? delegation.
The published implementation encodes its type and includes its payload size,
but omits the payload. Reuse the existing upstream MouseRelPdu encoder; do not
implement another wire encoder. See relative-input.patch for the complete diff.
All three owning Cargo workspaces select this same patched release.
